name: molab
description: Operate Molab notebooks through native marimo pairing with safe foreground jobs and artifact persistence.

interface.longDescription: Connect directly to live Molab marimo runtimes, edit reactive notebooks, run long GPU work as attached interactive cells, handle session termination safely, preserve artifacts under current Molab storage policy, and protect sandbox credentials.
defaultPrompt: Pair with this Molab notebook and run the task.
Run this code in Molab and monitor it.
Inspect and download Molab logs and artifacts.
